text: {"lessons":["Taking profits on Stock B felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on my portfolio plan rather than the pleasure of locking in gains.","Selling Stock C at a gain was a reminder to review each position consistently and avoid letting gains or losses alone dictate my decisions.","My account value fell in the last two periods despite earlier gains; short-term performance is uncertain, so I should stay diversified and make disciplined decisions rather than react to recent changes."]}
